note: Hands on evenly spaced frames of the videos without calibration, labeled by eye on a grid. Each entry is [x, y, kind] or [x, y, kind, side]: hand center as a fraction of the image width and height (accurate to about half a grid cell; 'grid' = columns, rows). kind 'hand' = a hand of the camera wearer, clearly visible: it must be found. kind 'ignore' = a hand of the wearer that is partly outside the image, hidden behind an object or blurred beyond recognition: neither required nor counted as an error (in B02 and L04 also a bystander's hand). kind 'other' = somebody else's hand: a skeleton on it is an error. side 'L' / 'R' = the wearer's left or right hand, '?' = unknown. B02 (94 frames) and L04 (95 frames) carry no side; the other six samples have 59 or 60 frames. Frames in 'skipped_frames' are unreadable (motion blur) and not scored. Frames with an empty list show no hand.
